purpose: Teach: 北方/ケネディ/都立/近鉄/東急/Ｊリーグ/エンジニアリング/デスノート

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが北方領土の歴史を教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to tell you about the history of the Northern Territories.
lines.style: Warm, gently informing tone. Slight upward lift on Sho's name—like calling him to attention. Measured pace. A touch of delight in sharing something she knows will interest him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとケネディ大統領のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei, I watched a Kennedy documentary with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo, punctuated excitement. Slight breathiness—he's been holding this news. Direct eye contact in his voice, wanting her to be as excited as he is.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが都立高校の同窓会に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went to his high school alumni gathering.
lines.style: Conversational, sharing news. Even delivery. Slight warm pause before the verb—like she's thinking aloud about what he's been up to. Gentle, observant tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと近鉄電車に乗ったよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei, I rode on the Kintetsu train with Dad.
lines.style: Genuine delight, not performed. Quieter than before—a smaller, more personal memory. Soft attack. Trailing upward slightly at the end, inviting her into the memory with him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが東急ハンズに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you to Tokyu Hands.
lines.style: Warm anticipation in her voice. Slow, deliberate tempo—letting each word land. Slight emphasis on the activity itself, like she's savoring his upcoming excitement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、Ｊリーグの試合観たいよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei, I want to watch a J-League match.
lines.style: Earnest longing. Slightly hesitant—not quite a request, more a wish stated aloud. Soft opening, trailing upward. The voice of a child testing whether it's okay to want things.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエンジニアリングのお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling you about engineering.
lines.style: Appreciative, noting something thoughtful he's learned. Calm, interested tempo. Slight warmth on 'engineering'—acknowledging the seriousness of the topic. A small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、デスノートはぼくにはまだ難しいって、お父さんが
lines.en: Big sister Mei, Dad says Death Note is still too hard for me.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly disappointed but accepting. Quieter than his earlier lines. Not quite resigned—more thoughtful. He's processing what his dad said. Soft, earnest delivery.
